_comment: Profile 1 (2026) numbers the validator enforces. Triangle budgets are not repeated here: they are read from spec/spec.json (profile.budgets) unless a profile file supplies its own `budgets` object keyed by class, for example { "small_prop": 10000 }. The _source fields name the line each number came from.
name: Profile 1 (2026)
_source_scale_tolerance: docs/capability-profiles.md, Mesh rules: 'Scale tolerance: Within 2% of the task's dimensions'
_source_mating_tolerance_m: docs/capability-profiles.md, Mesh rules: 'Mating dimensions within 1 mm'
_source_connector_tolerance: docs/capability-profiles.md, Mesh rules: 'Connector tolerance: Position within 1 mm, direction within 0.5 degrees'
_source_dimension_record_tolerance_m: Not in the specs. Chosen: recorded dimensions_m may differ from the file by at most 1 mm (see NOTES.md, Spec gaps).
_source_collision: docs/capability-profiles.md, Mesh rules: 'Collision shapes: One to eight convex shapes per atom'
_source_texture: docs/capability-profiles.md, Textures and materials: 4,096 x 4,096 maximum, at least 128 pixels on a side, 512 pixels per metre (pixels per metre is reported but not enforced)
_source_materials: docs/capability-profiles.md, Textures and materials: 'At most 3 on an S asset, 6 on an M or L asset'
_source_require_custom_material_maps: docs/asset-spec.md, Materials and textures: base colour, normal and occlusion-roughness-metallic are required for custom materials. A profile for flat-colour libraries sets this to false.
_source_folder_max_bytes: docs/capability-profiles.md, Textures and materials: 'Under 100 MB' (read as 100,000,000 bytes)
_source_zero_area_m2: Not in the specs. A face under 0.0001 mm^2 counts as zero area.
_source_weld_m: Not in the specs. Vertices within 1 micrometre count as the same point when matching faces and edges.
